name: Neon night cities
description: Rain-wet cyberpunk streets, towers and film-still sci-fi at night, plus flat synthwave sunsets and grids.
light: neon magenta and cyan signs, wet reflections, haze; a low orange sun disc in the synthwave variant
composition: street-level one-point perspective or a skyline band, one small figure or car, deep haze in the distance
camera_or_medium: cinematic film still, or flat vector synthwave illustration
texture_detail: rain, mist, subtle light bloom, film grain in stills
subjects: an empty rain-wet alley with neon signs
a hovercar crossing between megatowers in fog
a lone figure on a rooftop over a neon skyline
a synthwave sun over a purple grid horizon
